# chainlaunch_sync_all_external_nodes (Resource)

Automatically synchronizes external nodes from ALL connected remote Chainlaunch instances.

This resource discovers all connected peers and syncs their nodes automatically - no need to specify individual peer_node_ids. It always runs on every terraform apply to keep external nodes synchronized.

The resource will:
- Discover all connected peer nodes automatically
- Sync nodes from each connected peer in parallel
- Aggregate results across all peers
- Track per-peer sync results and errors

Use this instead of 'chainlaunch_external_nodes_sync' when you want to sync from all connected peers without manually specifying each peer_node_id.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `besu_nodes_added` (Number) Total number of Besu nodes added across all peers
- `besu_nodes_deleted` (Number) Total number of Besu nodes deleted across all peers
- `fabric_orderers_added` (Number) Total number of Fabric orderers added across all peers
- `fabric_orderers_deleted` (Number) Total number of Fabric orderers deleted across all peers
- `fabric_peers_added` (Number) Total number of Fabric peers added across all peers
- `fabric_peers_deleted` (Number) Total number of Fabric peers deleted across all peers
- `id` (String) Resource identifier (timestamp of sync)
- `last_sync_at` (String) Timestamp of the last successful sync
- `organizations_added` (Number) Total number of organizations added across all peers
- `peer_node_ids` (List of String) List of peer node IDs that were synced
- `sync_results` (Attributes List) Detailed sync results for each peer (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sync_results))

<a id="nestedatt--sync_results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sync_results`

Read-Only:

- `besu_nodes_added` (Number) Number of Besu nodes added from this peer
- `besu_nodes_deleted` (Number) Number of Besu nodes deleted from this peer
- `error` (String) Error message if sync failed
- `fabric_orderers_added` (Number) Number of Fabric orderers added from this peer
- `fabric_orderers_deleted` (Number) Number of Fabric orderers deleted from this peer
- `fabric_peers_added` (Number) Number of Fabric peers added from this peer
- `fabric_peers_deleted` (Number) Number of Fabric peers deleted from this peer
- `organizations_added` (Number) Number of organizations added from this peer
- `peer_node_id` (String) The peer node ID that was synced
- `success` (Boolean) Whether the sync was successful
